seasons.plot: Nothing is out of bounds in the first season of this SPIKE original comedy. At the center of the action are the Blue Mountain State Goats, the team with the nastiest sacks in all of college football. With a freshman lineup that includes a backup quarterback who’d rather party than play, a star running back who can’t score with the ladies, and a team mascot who redefines "personal foul," will they be able to juggle football, girls, class and nonstop hazing?

seasons.plot: The nastiest sacks in college football are back in a new season of balls-out comedy. Whether they're guzzling beers, hazing cheerleaders, kidnapping mascots, or crippling opponents with low blows, The Blue Mountain State Goats come ready to play hard and party harder.

seasons.plot: Blue Mountain State follows the on and off-field antics of college football powerhouse, Blue Mountain State. In season 3, Coach Daniels will have his authority challenged when the boosters force him to hire a hotshot offensive coordinator/head coach-in-waiting. While Alex will have to step up from being a fun-loving second-string to the starting QB.

episodes.name: Il capitano
episodes.plot: Mentre Alex si abitua a essere quarterback titolare e capitano, Thad aspetta notizie sul suo futuro con la squadra dopo il suo arresto per droga.

episodes.name: Foto compromettenti

Three incoming freshman in a big-time, Midwestern college football program have to juggle football, girls, class and nonstop hazing.
translations.tagline: Go long. Go deep. Go state!

overview.value: Alla Blue Mountain State, il college più scalmanato del paese, gli atleti scoprono gli alti - e bassi - di far parte dei pochi eletti idolatrati nel campus.
Il Coach Marty Daniels è sotto pressione per concludere una stagione vincente dopo che l'imbarazzante spettacolo dell'anno prima ha messo a rischio il suo lavoro.
Nella terza stagione, l'autorità del Coach Daniels viene minacciata quando i promotori lo obbligano ad assumere un coordinatore/aspirante capo allenatore vanitoso e offensivo.
